title: Mass-loss dependence of accretion-history correlations in dark-matter halo velocity structure: analysis materials
description:
Reproduction materials for Mass-loss dependence of accretion-history correlations in dark-matter halo velocity structure, by Stephen Atalebe. This release contains the article and supplementary material, original analysis code, selected per-object catalogues and model matrices, full-precision results, saved random-stream specifications, permutation outputs, spatial deletion records, and executable verification tools.

The analysis concerns population-dependent, contemporaneous accretion-history correlations. Recorded mass-loss controls substantially attenuate the original increments. Spatial reference calculations remain pointwise and fixed-parameter; global residual-permutation comparisons require unverified exchangeability. This release does not establish a dynamical memory law, jointly calibrated spatial/search inference, or the conditional association in formation-incomplete objects.

The repository documents the tested reproduction boundary. The main and recovered numerical pipelines can be replayed from included inputs without access to the private development repository. Large raw simulation trees and certain upstream/secondary producer routes are separate; supplied summaries are not relabelled complete raw-data reconstruction. AI assistance with ChatGPT and Claude is disclosed in the manuscript. This archive is not independent human peer review.
